answers.moment: a man in a work polo came in behind her, got a bottle of water out the fridge n walked off, she didnt even turn round lol

av_event.line_text: Leanne: Ooh, that sounds amazing. I go to me mum's for Sunday dinner. She does the Yorkshire puddings and she still won't let me make them. I'm forty-one! She says I open the oven too much.
av_event.what: A man in his fifties in a work polo shirt walks into frame behind Marisol, opens the fridge door, takes out a bottle of water, closes it and walks back out of shot. Marisol does not turn round and keeps looking at the screen.
